item.title: The Pixel 11 Pro is a great phone, no thanks to its flashiest new features
item.summary: Google is trying to get you off your phone. The Pixel 11 Pro is "A Phone Designed to Help You Use It Less," the company promises. It can proactively help you book restaurant reservations, take the best frames from a video, and help you voice-text significantly faster. The pitch is that the new features bundled […]
